description: §19.10.3 (S478; code name confirmed S479) — a `return` that leaves a `transaction` block after the block wrote rolls the write back and is reported as the Warning W-TX-EXIT-ROLLS-BACK.
provenance: ruling:user-voice-scrml.md S478 "⭐ RULED — open owner questions, PA recs adopted wholesale" item 22 · ruling:user-voice-scrml.md S479 "⭐ RULED — S478 hand-off §3.A and §3.B, PA recs adopted" item 2 (code name confirmed)
rationale: §19.10.3: "A `return`, or a `break` / `continue` whose target is outside the block, that leaves a `transaction { … }` block after the block wrote SHALL be reported as the Warning **W-TX-EXIT-ROLLS-BACK**".
